vgroup.description: Name of the group (gvw_group) — must match the Galera cluster name.

vaddress.description: Initial cluster address (GComm protocol). Usually left as 'gcomm://' for arbitrators to join via discovery or use explicit node list via gvw_lib.

vlib_path.description: Absolute path to the Galera library (libgalera.so) to load.

cluster_name.description: Name of the Galera cluster; must match wsrep_cluster_name on all Galera nodes.

ssl_enabled.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS encryption for arbitrator-to-cluster communication.

ssl_ca_path.description: Path to the SSL CA certificate file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL client private key file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0=error, 1=warn, 2=info, 3=debug. Lower values = less verbose.

log_file.description: Path to a log file; leave empty to log to syslog instead.

recovery_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for recovery state before exiting.

bootstrap.description: Whether to force bootstrap mode (only if starting the arbitrator in isolation, e.g., after full cluster loss).
